characters.name: The Donnelly Brothers
characters.description: Anti-Hero: There are worse people than any of them (except maybe Jimmy) everywhere you look, and they have varying degrees of honor and compassion, but an objective observer would probably call the city safer without them in it. Aw, Look! They Really Do Love Each Other: They fight and sometimes betray each other in matters of varying importance but have an enduring affection and loyalty that usually strengthens under serious adversity. Churchgoing Villain: They wereRaised Catholicand still take parts of it seriously, especially Tommy, who at one point sincerely promises to God that he won't kill anyone again before repeatedly breaking that promise because of his family responsibilities and the enemies they have. The Family That Slays Together: They are brothers who sink more and more into serious crimes and their late father, despite his good reputation, was the same way, and Jimmy's long-time partner Joanie shares his bed and some of his criminal plots. Fighting Irish: They are Irish-American brothers quick to pick fights and quick to win them.

characters.name: Joey Ice Cream
characters.description: Butt-Monkey: Arguably—the brothers get him to do all sorts of favors and menial tasks without showing much gratitude.Kevin:(as a huge dog chases Joey, whom they used as bait)I thought Joey could run faster than that. Guns Akimbo: Joey does this in the penultimate episode when Tommy goes after Dokey.OK, no, he doesn't,but that's the first version he tells. The Reliable One: For anOnly Sane by Comparisondegree of reliable. The brothers may razz him a lot, but he is constantly in their corner and rarely messes anything up nearly as bad as Jimmy and Kevin do. Unreliable Narrator: Joey telling the story from prison at some point in the future. He injects himself into scenes he couldn't possibly have been at, contradicts himself, makes himself sound less ridiculous than he really was, gets called out on lies, and tries to gloss over details.

characters.name: Jenny Reilly
characters.description: First Girl Wins: It's not that Tommy doesn't date. It'scertainlynot that Tommy doesn't notice other women. But Jenny Reilly will always have his heart. No Accounting for Taste: The men in her life, while much more industrious and innocent at first glance, tend to be capable of surprising deceit or violence. Silk Hiding Steel: She is a kindly diner operator looking out for her dad and despising the local gangs but can brashly stand up to or physically harm people who push her to far.

characters.name: Nicky Cotero
characters.description: Affably Evil: He's the most actively malicious character in the early episodes and retains some nasty ambition afterward but has a certain sense of dignity and willingness to be honest and generous with the people who earn his friendship or respect. Almighty Janitor: He is a street level sub-lieutenant in the mob but has more insight, vision, and hidden influence than most people realize. Even Bad Men Love Their Mamas: He brings canoli by his mom's house. Hookers and Blow: His social life outside of organized crime mostly consists of going to strip clubs where touching is allowed. Xanatos Speed Chess: He is constantly manipulating other people to try and take over the Italian mob while adjusting schemes as he learns more information, sees new opportunities, or becomes less of a nemesis and more of a friend to the Donnellys.

characters.name: Helen Donnelly
characters.description: Locked Out of the Loop: She is kept from knowing most of what her sons are up to and jumps to various wrong conclusions, like who beat up Sean. Mama Bear: Helen to the boys. In possibly the harshest example, when the brothers don't tell her the real reason behind Sean's beating, she comes to the conclusion that his girlfriend Kim was responsible and accordingly chases Kim off harshly. When Kim refuses to return Sean's calls later on, he assumes that it's because she was turned off by watching him get his ass kicked, and Helen is content to let him think this - untilKevininforms him what really happened. Sour Outside, Sad Inside: She can be bitter and controlling, but the finale hints she has a lot of guilt for putting her late husband on the path that got him killed.

characters.name: Dokey Farrell
characters.description: Even Evil Has Loved Ones: He wants to avenge his brother and seems to like spending time with his nephew (the feeling isn't too mutual). Sketchy Successor: He's a lot more cold-blooded and prone toStupid Evilthan the brother he is taking over for and no one thinks the neighborhood is better off for it. Tom the Dark Lord: He's a mob boss who chops people's toes off with an axe andgot his nickname from playing the Hokey Pokey a lot as a kid.

characters.name: Whitey Waylon
characters.description: Evil Nephew: He helps Jimmy kill his uncle, although the guy was a vicious killer who threatened Whitey on a regular basis and was poised to kill the Donnellys. Lightning Bruiser: He is a fairly strong-looking guy, lasts a while in a knife fight, and is the best runner in the neighborhood.
